excerpt.zh: 我们的恒星[Target.GetName]最近的行为极度怪异，它的能量产出远远低于平常。如果不能尽快找到应对措施，我们将会面临生态灾难！
excerpt.en: Our star, [Target.GetName], has been acting extremely oddly recently, generating a lot less energy than usual. If this is not remedied soon we could be facing ecological disaster!

label.en: Well, get them out of there!
Well, get them out of there!

texts.zh: 我们的恒星[Target.GetName]最近的行为极度怪异，它的能量产出远远低于平常。如果不能尽快找到应对措施，我们将会面临生态灾难！
texts.en: Our star, [Target.GetName], has been acting extremely oddly recently, generating a lot less energy than usual. If this is not remedied soon we could be facing ecological disaster!

texts.zh: [capital_star.GetName]被微型噬星者感染了！我们不明白这些星神兽幼体到底是怎么跑到我们的恒星上的，明明它们不具有任何超光速能力。我们可以在未来对其进行研究，但当下我们最要紧的是研究如何停止它们的寄生，否则我们的整个首都就要被彻底冻死了。
texts.en: [capital_star.GetName] is infested with tiny Stellar Devourers! We have no clue how these neonate leviathans have managed to get to our star as they don't seem to possess any FTL capabilities. We can uncover all that later. For now, we need to discover a way to stop the parasites before our capital freezes over.

label.en: Well, get them out of there!

texts.zh:
今天对[owner.GetName]而言是地狱般的一天，我们的首都恒星[target.GetName]熄灭了。尽管有数百万人撤离，但这对于我们遭受的打击来说不过杯水车薪。我们的首都永远地陷入了冰河时期。[target.GetName]则缩水成了一颗褐矮星，这就意味着这个恒星系里任何生命都不再适合生存了。
我们推测这些噬星者很有可能是由[star_infesters.GetName]送到我们的恒星上的，现在我们要他们血债血偿。
texts.en:
Today was a terrible day for the [owner.GetName], as our capital star [target.GetName] went out. Despite having evacuated many millions it only slightly softens the blow. Our capital is forever lost to a new and permanent ice age. [target.GetName] itself has shrunken to become a brown dwarf star, meaning life remaining in the system will permanently be diminished.
We know that these Devourers were purposely introduced to our star by the [star_infesters.GetName] - and now they shall suffer.

texts.zh:
今天对[owner.GetName]而言是地狱般的一天，我们的首都恒星[target.GetName]熄灭了。尽管有数百万人撤离，但这对于我们遭受的打击来说不过杯水车薪。我们的首都永远地陷入了冰河时期。[target.GetName]则缩水成了一颗褐矮星，这就意味着这个恒星系里任何生命都不再适合生存了。
很遗憾，究竟是什么把这些噬星者带到我们星系的仍不得而知。目前是灾后重建的时候了。
texts.en:
Today was a terrible day for the [owner.GetName], as our capital star [target.GetName] went out. Despite having evacuated many millions it only slightly softens the blow. Our capital is forever lost to a new and permanent ice age. [target.GetName] itself has shrunken to become a brown dwarf star, meaning life remaining in the system will permanently be diminished.
Sadly, this freak occurrence that delivered the Stellar Devourers to our system will remain a mystery. For now, we must rebuild.

title.zh: 找到噬星者寄生的解决方案。
title.en: Find a Cure for the Stellar Devourer Infestation

texts.zh: [This.GetName]受到噬星者的寄生。我们不确定它们从何而来，只知道必须尽快移除它们，否则星系内的所有生命都将在劫难逃。
texts.en: [This.GetName] has become infested with Stellar Devourers. We are unsure where they came from, but they need to be removed soon or else all life in the system might be at an end.
